title: cli: a use-runtime `os deploy` stopped on installation-wide uniques prints `os deploy --confirm-global-uniques`, a flag `os deploy` does not declare
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

## What is wrong

With a self-hosted runtime as the deploy target (`os environments use-runtime`), `os deploy` installs through the package-install command with `command.retryCommand = 'os deploy'` (`packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts` L321). When the runtime answers `UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, the install path prints the retry as `${retry} --confirm-global-uniques` (`packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts` L445-L456, `retry` set at L323). So the author is told to run `os deploy --confirm-global-uniques`. `os deploy` declares `--confirm-access-upgrade` and `--confirm-upgrade` (deploy.ts L140-L155) but no `--confirm-global-uniques`; only `os package install` declares it (install.ts L275, L424). The printed retry fails on an unknown flag, and the deploy path has no way to pass the confirmation.

Read on `main` `604a2b3b9`. This predates PR #31335 (#31235), whose contract review (6716322584) found it while checking the use-runtime exit-1 cases. That PR's skill paragraph teaches nothing false about it.

## Suggested shape

Either `os deploy` declares `--confirm-global-uniques` and forwards it on the runtime path (as it already does for the two upgrade confirmations), or the printed retry on the deploy path names the command that does take it. Then the docs (`content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` § To a self-hosted runtime) and the platform skill's use-runtime exit-1 paragraph name the stop.
